blocks.text: 東南西北 搬山渡海 只有夢中 父母故鄉
blocks.spelling: tang-lâm-sai-pak puann suann tōo-hái tsí-ū bāng-tiong pē-bú kòo-hiong

blocks.text: 一个人佇都市流浪 為前途陪孤單假勇
blocks.spelling: tsi̍t ê lâng tī too-tshī liû-lōng uî tsiân tôo puê koo-tuann ké ióng

blocks.text: 猶原是彼卡皮箱 添無斤兩
blocks.spelling: iu-guân sī hit khá phuê-siunn thinn bô kin-niú

blocks.text: 未來是河 我泅啊泅
blocks.spelling: bī-lâi sī hô guá siû ah siû

blocks.text: 成功若一堵牆 一條港都夜雨唱煞閣唱
blocks.spelling: sîng-kong ná tsi̍t tóo tshiûnn tsi̍t tiâu káng to iā-ú tshiùnn suah koh tshiùnn

blocks.text: 空空的彼卡皮箱 破毋成樣
blocks.spelling: khang khang ê hit khá phuê-siunn phuà m̄-tsiânn-iūnn

blocks.text: 當時我彼卡皮箱 滇滇若夢彼一樣
blocks.spelling: tong-sî guá hit khá phuê-siunn tīnn tīnn ná bāng hit tsi̍t-iūnn

blocks.text: 回鄉的路猶外遠 毋敢想
blocks.spelling: huê hiong ê lōo iáu guā hn̄g m̄ kánn siūnn
